svg.title: EWS NL2SQL application architecture
svg.desc: Source-verified EWS NL2SQL V4.3 logical architecture. Nine numbered request stages, existing office UI and pending ingress, shared Redis admission, separate SQLite query/session/metadata stores, gated Oracle and LLM adapters, optional embeddings/FAISS, and an out-of-worker metadata approval/publication workflow. Azure-style generic symbols do not imply Azure deployment.
svg.text: V4.3 / Logical architecture of the implemented backend and its office integration boundaries
LOCAL PROFILE: synthetic SQLite + shared Redis; LLM disabled. VM profile: 2 workers. Office Oracle, inference and corporate identity need qualification.
Host OS and cloud platform are undecided; the API remains loopback-bound.
FASTAPI WORKERS · spawned factory; pools, indexes and clients belong to each worker
ONE PINNED SNAPSHOT: catalog + grants + certified graph + retrieval + compiler / validator + query adapter
Certified template or grounded model path
Only metadata allowed by current grants
Certified joins, grain, units and scope
DOMAIN FOUNDATION · immutable Pydantic contracts + typed application ports
Adapters implement ports; domain / use cases do not import transport or infrastructure.
No results, grants or history cache
Local volume; network shares / multi-node operation unqualified
Separate administrative process; scheduling is disabled by default
Drain old leases; preserve revoked grants
Alternative office query backend · requires approved Oracle configuration
SOURCE-VERIFIED · 21 OCT 2026 · Logical topology; Azure hosting is not assumed.
Microsoft generic SVG symbols · editable draw.io source included
Crossing lines without a junction are independent. Health/readiness and sanitized request-stage logs support the API; external monitoring and office ingress are owner integrations.
